title: Adaptive Log Anomaly Detection through Data-Centric Drift Characterization and Policy-Driven Lifelong Learning

contributions.purpose: 为日志异常检测中的概念漂移提供可解释分类
contributions.mechanism: 数据中心drift taxonomy:用统计检验与新颖性检测将漂移分为semantic(已知模板内频率变化)与syntactic(新模板涌现)
contributions.evaluation: 定性:引入可解释漂移类型区分(评测中用drift-type-aware F1)
contributions.domain: 日志异常检测/终身学习
contributions.source_quote: Our contributions include: a drift taxonomy for log data, a dual policy adaptation mechanism that uses experience replay and model expansion, and comprehensive evaluations on both synthetic and real-world datasets.

contributions.purpose: 按漂移类型做定向更新以缓解灾难性遗忘
contributions.mechanism: policy-driven lifelong learning manager:semantic漂移用experience replay,syntactic漂移用dynamic model expansion
contributions.evaluation: 定性:高效适应、缓解遗忘、较monolithic重训降开销(无绝对数值对比)
contributions.source_quote: a policy-driven lifelong learning manager applies targeted updates—experience replay to mitigate forgetting under semantic drift and dynamic model expansion to accommodate syntactic drift.

contributions.purpose: 在真实数据集上验证并保存历史知识
contributions.mechanism: 在HDFS/Apache/BGL及半合成日志上评测final F1、drift-type-aware F1、前后向迁移、计算成本
contributions.evaluation: 维持高F1、降开销、保历史知识;但基线F1恒定1.0跨batch,作者自承可能提示数据泄漏
contributions.source_quote: the rapid decline in loss may also suggest data leakage, necessitating future investigation.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our method thus bridges existing gaps by linking interpretable drift taxonomy with policy-driven adaptation in a real-world context.

notes: AI披露checklist全部[D]。数据可信度红旗:基线F1在batch size 20-100间恒定为1.0,作者自认'rapid decline in loss may also suggest data leakage'并将该图挪到附录;真实数据集结果'confirms nearly perfect anomaly detection'同样可疑;全篇无数值结果表。trade-off:model expansion与replay frequency之间的平衡。desk-reject。
